instruction: I am going for a 20-minute drive without internet. Play an album from my Spotify library that already has enough downloaded songs for it, so I do not have to repeat.
notes: Single-app Spotify task. The agent must list library albums and downloaded songs, determine (per album, via show_album for the song list/durations) which album has >= 20 minutes (1200 s) of downloaded songs, and play that album. The quantitative check is abstracted into the static fact (downloaded-duration-covers ?album drive-20-minutes), which is only usable after the lookups (library-listed, downloads-listed, known-downloaded-duration). Playing uses play_music with album_id, which puts the whole album (all collection songs, including the downloaded ones) into the queue, satisfying the evaluation; clear_song_queue is required beforehand so no foreign songs remain in the queue (harmless if play_music already replaces the queue). No answer is needed, so supervisor-complete-task takes no parameters. Placeholder albums stand in for the real library albums; pagination of list APIs is not modeled.
